# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>; master  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Phillips had tears in his eyes when he gave his farewell speech to his pupils.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is known for being horrid, sarcastic, and prone to spasmodic fits of reform. He exhibits a solemn manner and acts as though his pupils ought to be free of evil passions. He can be hypocritical and lax with discipline at times, permitting talking in class when distracted, while punishing latecomers or minor offenses strictly. Despite his harshness, he displays an affectionate and romantic side toward Prissy Andrews and speaks affectingly when departing.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster in Avonlea. During his time at the school, he frequently paid special attention to Prissy Andrews, hearing her Latin lessons in the back of the room, giving her Mayflowers, and visiting her at home under the guise of helping her with her studies. He treated Anne Shirley harshly on several occasions, holding up her slate to humiliate her spelling, making her stand by the blackboard, and spelling her name without an 'e' on the board. He also whipped Sam Boulter for talking back, causing Sam's father to confront him at the schoolhouse. During a evening concert, Mr. Phillips gave a recitation of Mark Antony's oration while continually looking at Prissy Andrews. At the end of the term, he delivered an affecting farewell speech that brought his students to tears before leaving his teaching post at Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
